episodes.title: Khalil Amani on "Escaping Evil: My Life in a Cult." The Biography Channel 2013 Interview.
episodes.description:
From The Biography Channel series, "Escaping Evil: My Life in a Cult." 

For educational, research and entertainment purposes on understanding the religious cult experience. 

Professor Khalil Amani shares his cult experience as part of Yahweh Ben Yahweh's Hebrew Israelite cult in Miami, Florida, in the 1980's.
